potential_assists.note: The advanced payload has no potential_assists field. Passes were not used as a substitute.

rebound_chances_inconsistent.note: Off plus def did not equal total. The returned total was kept.

coverage.model_c_reason: Historical injuries and lineups were not available. Model C uses measured pace, defensive rating, usage, minutes, and rebound chances. It does not include teammate-absence redistribution.
coverage.potential_assists: Not present on GET /nba/v2/stats/advanced. Assists rows use the rate prior and are excluded from the complete-input comparison.
coverage.line_rule: One line per player and prop: the two-sided price closest to 50/50, chosen before any model ran. The same line is used for A, B, and C.

positional_effect.reading: Negative means the second model has the lower Brier.

full_versus_opportunity.reading: Negative means the second model has the lower Brier.

assists_incomplete.note: Potential assists were not in the historical feed. These rows are the rate prior.

parameter_update.reason: Production matchup weights and calibration settings were not changed.

report.sample_warning: Uncertainty is the game-clustered and date-clustered standard error. Props inside one game are not independent observations.
